devices.description: Numitron tube, incandescent 7-segment numeral and decimal point, 10 mm, wire leads
devices.note: IV-9 passport, datasheets/vfd/iv-9.pdf (segments from its digit table; the same as the IV-16 figure). A segment is a filament between its lead and the common: it lights with either polarity. Simulated as a common-anode display (common to +, a 7447-style driver sinking the segments). Segment 3.15 V nominal, 4.5 V max, 19.5 mA (17-22). Numeral height 10 mm from tube-tester.com (the IV-16 passport gives 12 x 6 mm for the same construction)

devices.description: Numitron tube, incandescent 7-segment numeral, 12 mm, wire leads
devices.note: IV-16 passports, datasheets/vfd/iv-16.pdf and iv-16-sparktube.jpg (segment figure; lead 2 is free: no decimal point; numeral 12 x 6 mm). A segment is a filament between its lead and the common: it lights with either polarity. Simulated as a common-anode display (common to +, a 7447-style driver sinking the segments). Segment 3.15 V nominal, 4.5 V max, 19.5 mA (17-22)

devices.description: VFD tube, 7-segment numeral and decimal point, 11.2 mm, side view, wire leads
devices.note: IV-6 passport, datasheets/vfd/iv-6.pdf (segment figure and digit table), and the reference page iv-6-sparktube.jpg (character 6.9 x 11.2 mm). A segment glows while its anode and the grid are both high (about 25 V) with the filament lit; the filament leads are not simulated. Leads 7 and 8 are the filament (8 also the conductive layer); anode and grid 25 V (30 V max; 50-70 V pulsed), filament 1.0 V 50 mA (the reference book says 1.2 V). The 12th lead is cut off

devices.description: VFD tube, 7-segment numeral, 21 mm, side view, 10 pins
devices.note: IV-12 passport, datasheets/vfd/iv-12.pdf (segment figure), and the reference book page iv-11_iv-12-refbook-p191.pdf. devices.description: VFD tube, 8 digits with decimal points and a symbol position, 10.5 mm, side view, wire leads
devices.note: No factory passport found: the reference page datasheets/vfd/iv-18-sparktube.jpg (outline, segment letters, character 5.4 x 10.5 mm) and tube-tester.com's sheet datasheets/vfd/iv-18.pdf (leads, grids, 5 V 85 mA filament, 20-30 V anode and grid). A segment glows while its anode and the grid are both high (about 25 V) with the filament lit; the filament leads are not simulated. The digits are multiplexed: one grid per digit, the sheets' digit 1 (G1) at the lead end, shown here as the rightmost digit (G8 is display digit 1). G9 is the symbol position (a dot and a dash) beyond digit 8: not simulated. Leads 6-8 are that position's own anodes in the reference page and not connected in the other sheet (19-lead and 22-lead tubes exist): no connection here

devices.description: VFD tube, 7-segment numeral and decimal point, 8.6 mm, flat bulb, flexible leads
devices.note: IV-8 passport drawing, datasheets/vfd/iv-8-rudatasheet.png (electrode diagram, segment figure, outline: bulb 10.8 x 36 mm, flexible leads 30 mm) and the reference books iv-8_iv-17_iv-22-refbook-0952-p62-69.pdf (Table 2-10, lead table) and iv-8_iv-17_iv-22_iv-25_iv-27-refbook-1122-p20-27.pdf. Leads 1 and 8 are the filament (8 also the conductive layer), 7 the grid; 4 and 11 are free and 14 is the shortened key lead. The 1122 book shows lead 7 as free, but the passport drawing and the 0952 table join it to the grid: the grid is used. A segment glows while its anode and the grid are both high (about 25 V) with the filament lit; the filament leads are not simulated. Filament 0.85 V 50 mA; anode and grid 25-30 V static (30 V max, 50-70 V pulsed); character 8.6 x 5.9 mm

devices.description: VFD tube, one 16-segment character with two commas, 16 mm, end view, wire leads
devices.note: IV-17 passport, datasheets/vfd/iv-17_01.pdf p.2 (outline, lead circle, segment figure with each segment's lead number) and the reference books iv-8_iv-17_iv-22-refbook-0952-p62-69.pdf and iv-8_iv-17_iv-22_iv-25_iv-27-refbook-1122-p20-27.pdf (lead table). Leads 1 (also the conductive layer) and 11 are the filament, 12 the grid, 22 the shortened key lead (free); the other 18 are the anodes. The segments are named A1/A2 (top bar, left/right), B and C (right verticals), D1/D2 (bottom bar), E and F (left verticals), G1/G2 (middle bar), H J K (upper left diagonal, centre bar, upper right diagonal), N M L (lower left diagonal, centre bar, lower right diagonal); the commas are DP (right, lead 10) and LDP (left, lead 2). A segment glows while its anode and the grid are both high (about 25 V) with the filament lit; the filament leads are not simulated. Filament 2.4 V 47 mA; anode and grid 25 V (30 V max, 50-70 V pulsed); segments 2.5 mA, grid 3-6 mA; character 10 x 16 mm

devices.description: VFD tube, 7-segment numeral and decimal point, 18 mm, end view, 12 pins
devices.note: IV-22 passport, datasheets/vfd/iv-22_01.pdf p.2 (base drawing, electrode diagram, segment figure, data) and the reference books iv-8_iv-17_iv-22-refbook-0952-p62-69.pdf and iv-8_iv-17_iv-22_iv-25_iv-27-refbook-1122-p20-27.pdf (lead table, which names the segments in the Russian order a-ж; the passport figure letters them a-h instead, the same leads). Leads 5 (also the conductive layer) and 12 are the filament, 6 the grid; 9 is free. A segment glows while its anode and the grid are both high (about 27 V) with the filament lit; the filament leads are not simulated. Filament 1.2 V (1.0-1.32) 100 mA; anode and grid 22-30 V static (80 V pulsed); segments 4 mA, grid 6-10 mA; character 12.4 x 18 mm; the IV-22A is the red version

devices.description: VFD tube, a row of seven round dots, 4 mm, no grid, flexible leads
devices.note: IV-25 passport, datasheets/vfd/iv-25-rudatasheet.png (lead diagram, outline, dot figure) and the reference book iv-8_iv-17_iv-22_iv-25_iv-27-refbook-1122-p20-27.pdf p.24-25 (connection table). Seven dots 4 mm across on a 7 mm pitch in a row (dots a-ж left to right, here P1-P7); lead 1 and lead 6 (also the conductive layer) are the filament. It has no grid: a dot glows while its anode is high (about 25 V) against the filament cathode, which the model takes as lead 6 (F2) held low, as an LED. Filament 2.4 V (2.0-2.65) 35 mA; anode 25 V (30 V max, pulsed up to 70 V), 4 mA in all

devices.description: VFD tube, 14 digits of 7 segments and decimal point, 8.5 mm, cylindrical bulb, two stems of flexible leads
devices.note: IV-27 passport, datasheets/vfd/iv-27_01.pdf (outline, the two stems, lead tables, data) and the reference book iv-8_iv-17_iv-22_iv-25_iv-27-refbook-1122-p20-27.pdf. The tube has a 21-lead stem at one end and an 11-lead stem at the other, so the pinout runs 1-22 for the first (lead 22 is the free shortened position; leads 2 4 6 8 11 14 16 18 are free) and 23-33 for the second (its leads 1-11 are pins 23-33). First stem: 1 (also the conductive layer) and 21 the filament, 17 19 3 20 grids of digits 1-4, 10 12 9 13 7 15 5 grids of digits 8-14. Second stem: segment anodes shared by all digits (leads 1-8: a b c d e f g and the point, in the passport's Russian order а б в г д е ж и, which are A F B G E C D DP) and the grids of digits 6, 5 and 7 (leads 9-11). Digits are numbered as in the passport. The digits are multiplexed: a segment glows while its anode and its digit's grid are both high (about 24 V) with the filament lit; the filament leads are not simulated. Filament 3.15 V 160 mA (AC from a centre-tapped winding preferred); anode and grid 24 V pulsed, 50 V max, duty 10; character 8.5 x 4.5 mm
